#{item.sfvhStaffId}

(SELECT MAX(task_acc_time) FROM T_TASK WHERE task_ope_staff_id = #{item.sfvhStaffId})

SELECT tf2.flgt_a_atot AS flgtAAtot, flight.flgt_d_etot AS flgtDEtot,tf2.flgt_chocks_in AS flgtChocksIn ,flight.flgt_chocks_out AS flgtChocksOut, ts.task_chag_sta_time AS taskChagStaTime,flight.flgt_d_stot AS flgtDStot, ts.task_chag_end_time AS taskChagEndTime,tf2.flgt_flno AS flgtFlno, ts.task_asg_time AS taskAsgTime,ts.task_acc_time AS taskAccTime,ts.task_arrive_time AS taskArriveTime, ts.task_rc_print_time AS taskRcPrintTime,ts.task_done_time AS taskDoneTime FROM T_FLIGHT flight LEFT JOIN T_TASK ts ON ts.task_flight_id = flight.flgt_id LEFT JOIN T_FLIGHT tf2 ON tf2.flgt_adid = 'A' AND flight.flgt_link_ffid = tf2.flgt_ffid WHERE flight.flgt_airport_code=#{flgtAirportCode} AND flight.flgt_flno=#{flightND} AND flight.flgt_id=#{aircraftID} AND flight.flgt_flop=CURDATE()
